cards.name: A-Urza's Command
cards.oracleText:
Choose two —
• Creatures you don't control get -3/-0 until end of turn.
• Create two tapped Powerstone tokens.
• Create a tapped 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
• Scry 2, then draw a card.

cards.name: A-Urza, Powerstone Prodigy
cards.oracleText:
{1}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever you discard one or more artifact cards, create a tapped Powerstone token. This ability triggers only once each turn. (The token is an artifact with "{T}: Add {C}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.")
